reading.zh: 左侧是旧草地瓦片与矩形调色板；右侧是局内地图两套皮肤——Kenney 主题（含 RuleTile 规则瓦片，按邻接自动拼接）与 Placeholder 灰盒主题（只有固定精灵 Tile）；对应的房间块 prefab 见 assets.runmap-kenney / runmap-greybox。
reading.en: Left: legacy grass tiles plus the rectangular palette. Right: the two in-game skins - Kenney themes (with RuleTiles that auto-tile by neighbour rules) and Placeholder greybox themes (fixed-sprite tiles only). Matching room-chunk prefabs live in assets.runmap-kenney / runmap-greybox.
